description: Release safety monitoring for a release app: view current backend health (status, uptime, recent checks, release watches), set the monitored health URL and toggle monitoring, auto-detect the health endpoint from a domain, or roll back the last release for a channel.

backend_health_url.description: For action=set: the backend health URL to monitor (null/empty to clear)

base.description: For action=detect: the app domain or base URL to probe for a health endpoint

channel.description: For action=rollback: the channel to roll back (default: production)

monitoring_enabled.description: For action=set: turn continuous monitoring on or off

name: ubriot_release_health
